name: Jewel Lamoreaux
bioAdditions: Giles & Franklin (1962) list James Lamoreux, eldest child of Ensign Thomas Lamoreux, as born 3 Jan 1774. They say he married Sarah Hunter and had ten children, 'among whom were Nathan and Jewell (?)' (S1). That makes Sarah Hunter Jewel's probable mother and Nathan a probable brother. The question mark is the authors' own. Nothing else about Jewel, 'a cripple child' in his grandfather's will, was found.
openQuestionsNew: Mother probably Sarah Hunter (Giles & Franklin). Check the 1830/1840 Luzerne censuses for a Jewel Lamoreaux.

sources.citation: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport ... and his Descendants (1962), p.357
sources.supports: father James b. 3 Jan 1774 m. Sarah Hunter; ten children including Nathan and 'Jewell (?)'
